quandoUsar: Ask for consent to optional cookies on the first visit, with accept, reject, and customize side by side, and declining as easy as accepting.
Let the user change their mind later: the choice becomes a round button in the corner that reopens the preferences, and `openPreferences()` through the `ref` serves a “Cookies” link in the footer.
Ask again when the policy changes: increase `version` and the choice saved under `storageKey` stops being valid.
quandoEvitar: Use `announcement-bar` for a top message that asks for no choice.
Use `dialog` when the flow requires blocking the page until a decision is made; this layer is not modal and the site remains usable behind it.
Use `switch` directly on a settings page when the privacy preferences are part of a larger form.

teclado.acao: With focus in the preferences panel, closes without saving and returns focus to the bar's “Customize” button or to the reopen button.
On a category's switch, toggles it in the draft; nothing is saved until “Save choices”, “Accept all”, or “Reject all”.
Moves through buttons and switches; there is no focus trap, because the layer is not modal.

acessibilidade: Bar and panel are `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal="false"`, with no focus trap; opening the panel moves focus to the title, and saving or closing returns focus to the bar or to the reopen button.
Each switch has a `<label>` and `aria-describedby` with the category description, and “Save choices” reports in hidden text how many optional categories are allowed.
The default texts are in English; pass `labels` (message, buttons, title, `reopen`, `alwaysOn`, `close`) to translate them, including the accessible names of the reopen and close buttons.
movimento: A single surface changes position, width, height, and radius with a no-overshoot spring between bar, panel, and round button; growing is slightly slower than shrinking.
The content of each shape swaps with a short fade, rising a few pixels from a slight blur, and the surface enters from below at nearly full scale.
With “reduce motion”, the shape changes immediately and only the content fades.
responsivo: The bar goes up to 660 px and the panel up to 420 px; below 560 px the bar stacks text and buttons, and in a very narrow bar (around 340 px) “Customize” drops to its own line.
The category list scrolls internally above `min(46vh, 300px)`; change the limit with the `--cookie-consent-list-max` variable.
notasIA: Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/cookie-consent/cookie-consent` (it uses `button` and `switch`). It only records the choice: load analytics or marketing scripts yourself, from `onChange` or `readCookieConsent(storageKey, version)`.
Mount it once in the layout with `storageKey`; nothing appears on the server or before storage is read. In a preview inside a card, use `strategy="absolute"` with a positioned parent.
For a “Cookies” link in the footer, keep a `ref` and call `openPreferences()`; `reset()` erases the choice and shows the bar again.
